Restyle this app so it looks like the rest of Repro Suite (see https://paperrepro-aiid.atoms.world/repro/index.html). Change only the look and the navigation; keep every feature, text, table and the EN / 中文 switch working as now.

DESIGN SYSTEM
- Light theme first, dark on a toggle button (☾ / ☀), remembered in localStorage key "repro.theme2".
- Light: background #FBFBFD, cards #FFFFFF, soft fill #F3F3F6, text #1D1D1F, secondary text #5C5C66, borders #E4E4EA, accent #2B59FF, accent tint #ECF0FF, success #15803D, warning #B45309, error #C62828. Dark: background #0B0B0E, cards #151519, soft #1C1C22, text #F4F4F6, secondary #ADADB8, borders #2A2A31, accent #7B96FF, accent tint #1B2146.
- Font Inter (Google Fonts) with Noto Sans SC for Chinese; JetBrains Mono for numbers, ids and code. Headlines weight 800, letter-spacing -0.035em. Cards radius 16px, 1px border, soft shadow 0 8px 24px rgba(16,24,40,.06). Pill buttons (radius 999px), primary = accent. Generous white space. One accent colour only; no serif fonts.

LAYOUT: left sidebar 248px (sticky, full height; under 900px a drawer opened from a ☰ button in a slim top bar). Top of the sidebar: black rounded square logo with a white letter "D", the app name "Repro Desk", grey line "part of Repro Suite". First group "Repro Desk": the app's own pages or sections (use the pages and sections it already has). Then group "Repro Suite" (new tab, small ↗): Paper Explainer https://paperexplainer-aiid.pub.atoms.world , Paper Repro Agent https://paperrepro-aiid.atoms.world/repro/index.html , Benchmark https://paperrepro-aiid.atoms.world/repro/bench.html , All apps https://reprosuite-aiid.atoms.world . Bottom: theme and language buttons. Remove the old top navigation bar.

# Project Summary
Repro Desk helps researchers assess whether a paper’s headline result can be reproduced. Its bilingual landing page explains an AI-assisted workflow—an agent reads the paper, writes and runs code, repeats the run from scratch and audits its work, then a human reviews the report. The site presents an explicitly illustrative sample report, shares summary figures for 32 papers and 6 models, offers three free pilot plans, and accepts paper-check requests.

An owner-only admin page supports request management and displays anonymous funnel statistics. Visit and form-start events are counted without collecting email or other personal details.

# Project Module Description
- **Landing page:** English and Chinese content, language preference, light/dark themes, workflow overview, sample report, honest-numbers section, pricing, FAQ, and request form.
- **Request submission:** Collects a paper link, claim, email, and selected pilot plan; validates and saves requests and returns a request number.
- **Anonymous analytics:** Records visits and form starts, at most once per browser session, and provides admin statistics for visits, form starts, submissions, and conversion.
- **Admin:** Owner-restricted page with funnel counters, request list, status filtering, pagination, and editable request status.
- **Authentication:** Sign-in, callback, and logout flows protect admin access.
- **Backend API:** Includes request, site-event, auth, user, settings, storage, health, and AI Hub endpoints.
- **Blog:** Blog pages, article rendering, and prerendering utilities.

# Directory Tree
```text
.
├── DESIGN.md
├── assets/images/                  # Landing-page imagery
└── app/
    ├── start_app_v2.sh             # Application startup helper
    ├── backend/
    │   ├── main.py                 # FastAPI application entry point
    │   ├── lambda_handler.py       # Serverless adapter
    │   ├── core/                   # Configuration, auth, database, telemetry
    │   ├── dependencies/           # Shared API dependencies
    │   ├── models/                 # Database models, including site events
    │   ├── schemas/                # API request and response schemas
    │   ├── routers/                # Request, event, auth, and other API routes
    │   ├── services/               # Business logic and integrations
    │   ├── data_models/            # Example, request, and site-event data
    │   ├── alembic/                # Database migrations
    │   ├── skills_docs/            # Integration and SDK guidance
    │   └── requirements.txt        # Python dependencies
    └── frontend/
        ├── package.json            # Frontend scripts and dependencies
        ├── vite.config.ts          # Vite configuration
        ├── prerender/              # Blog prerendering and sitemap utilities
        ├── plugins/                # Development safeguards and tests
        ├── public/                 # Static assets and crawler rules
        └── src/
            ├── App.tsx             # Application routes and layout
            ├── pages/              # Landing, admin, auth, and blog pages
            ├── components/         # Site header, request form, and UI components
            ├── contexts/           # Authentication, language, and theme state
            ├── api/                # Feature API helpers
            ├── lib/                # Client, content, tracking, and utilities
            └── *.css               # Application and global styles
```

# File Description Inventory
- **`DESIGN.md`** — Design and architecture notes.
- **`app/start_app_v2.sh`** — Application startup helper.
- **`app/backend/main.py` / `lambda_handler.py`** — Backend application setup and serverless entry point.
- **`app/backend/core/`** — Shared configuration, authentication, database setup, encryption, and telemetry.
- **`app/backend/models/` and `schemas/`** — Database entities and API contracts, including site events and reproduction requests.
- **`app/backend/routers/repro_requests.py`** — Reproduction-request endpoints.
- **`app/backend/routers/site_events.py` and `services/site_events.py`** — Anonymous event tracking and admin statistics.
- **`app/backend/data_models/site_events.json`** — Site-event data model definitions.
- **`app/backend/alembic/`** — Database migration setup and revisions, including the site-events migration.
- **`app/backend/services/`** — Request handling, auth, database, storage, payment, user, and AI Hub logic.
- **`app/backend/requirements.txt`** — Backend Python dependencies.
- **`app/backend/skills_docs/`** — AI, custom API, object storage, and web SDK guidance.
- **`app/frontend/package.json`** — Frontend dependencies and scripts.
- **`app/frontend/src/App.tsx`** — Application routing and layout.
- **`app/frontend/src/pages/`** — Landing page, owner admin page, authentication callbacks, and blog pages.
- **`app/frontend/src/components/RequestForm.tsx`** — Pilot-plan selection and request submission form.
- **`app/frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx`** — Site navigation and theme toggle.
- **`app/frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx`** — Persistent light/dark theme state.
- **`app/frontend/src/lib/track.ts`** — Client-side visit and form-start tracking.
- **`app/frontend/src/lib/client.ts` and `content.ts`** — API client and localized site content.
- **`app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.tsx`** — Funnel counters and request-status management.
- **`app/frontend/src/pages/Index.tsx`** — Bilingual landing-page content and sections.
- **`app/frontend/src/api/` and `src/lib/`** — API helpers, auth, blog/content, settings, and utilities.
- **`app/frontend/prerender/`** — Blog route, article, and sitemap prerendering.
- **`app/frontend/plugins/`** — Development safeguards and tests.
- **`app/frontend/public/`** — Static assets and crawler rules.
- **`app/frontend/site.config.json` and `template_config.json`** — Site and template configuration.
- **`assets/images/`** — Hero, report, and team-review imagery.

# Technology Stack
- **Frontend:** React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and reusable UI components.
- **Backend:** Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and Alembic.
- **Authentication and integrations:** Atoms Cloud Web SDK and backend services.
- **Quality checks:** ESLint, Playwright configuration, and frontend plugin tests.

# Usage
- Install frontend dependencies in `app/frontend` using the package manager matching the lockfile. Use the scripts in `package.json` to run development, lint, and production build tasks.
- Create a Python virtual environment in `app/backend` and install dependencies from `requirements.txt`.
- Configure database, authentication, and platform environment settings before starting the backend.
- Apply database migrations with Alembic when setting up or updating the database.
- `app/start_app_v2.sh` is available as an application startup helper.

Frontend linting, production build, Python syntax checks, and an English light-mode visual check passed for this change. Chinese content, dark mode, mobile layout, request submission, and admin login were not verified. New analytics counters begin at zero; existing requests may retain older plan codes.
